slides.title: 문 셋 중 하나를 골라 보세요
slides.purpose: Pick one of three closed doors before any goat or prize is exposed.
slides.successCheck: Can distinguish chosen door from still-hidden prize.
slides.representation: Three accessible closed-door buttons; no probability result or prize clue.
slides.interaction: Choose 1/2/3; preserve choice on navigation/restoration; no selection gate, default example is door1.

slides.title: 다른 문 하나는 꽝이었습니다
slides.purpose: Expose one unchosen goat in a fixed seeded illustrative round, without revealing the winner.
slides.successCheck: Can name the chosen, opened and remaining doors and consider staying versus switching.
slides.representation: Same three doors retain selected identity; exactly one unchosen goat is visible.
slides.interaction: Opening choice carries through; no new click required. The illustration uses an informed host internally but cannot prove an omitted host rule.

slides.title: 진행자는 반드시 꽝을 엽니다
slides.purpose: Declare equal prize placement, independent initial choice, informed always-goat and always-offer rules.
slides.successCheck: Can state which rule guarantees that the host avoids the prize.
slides.representation: Static concise rule sequence; no full probability ledger.
slides.interaction: Static declaration; immediate navigation.

slides.title: 꽝 문이 둘이면 반반으로 고릅니다
slides.purpose: Declare fair tie-breaking for the concrete informed-host example without claiming it is required for overall switching success.
slides.successCheck: Can state that both available goats are chosen with probability1/2 and separate this from the always-goat obligation.
slides.representation: Two equally weighted opening branches when the initially chosen door hides the prize; no inferred host preference.
slides.interaction: Uses current chosen door; this explicit standard protocol is fixed in the mainline.

slides.title: 처음 고른 문에 상품이 있다면?
slides.purpose: Work the initially correct prize location.
slides.successCheck: Can explain why switching leaves the prize.
slides.representation: Three doors show prize behind selected door, goat opened elsewhere and switching loss.
slides.interaction: Use current chosen door; preserve it, never infer a probability from this one case.

slides.title: 상품이 다른 한쪽 문에 있다면?
slides.purpose: Work the first unchosen prize location.
slides.successCheck: Can identify the only goat the informed host may open and why switching wins.
slides.representation: Same door identities, prize at first unchosen door, forced goat opening.
slides.interaction: Current chosen door retained; this is an explicit hypothetical prize case, not a new sampled outcome.

slides.title: 나머지 문에 상품이 있어도?
slides.purpose: Work the other unchosen prize location.
slides.successCheck: Can explain why the second initially wrong case also switches to the prize.
slides.representation: Prize and forced goat exchange positions while selected door stays fixed.
slides.interaction: Current choice retained; deterministic hypothetical comparison.

slides.title: 가지 끝의 확률은 같지 않습니다
slides.purpose: Expose informed-host prize→opening branches and multiply their stated probabilities.
slides.successCheck: Derive joint path weights1/6,1/6,1/3,1/3 and switching mass2/3; do not count four leaves equally.
slides.representation: A connected semantic probability tree labels prior1/3, each opening chance1/2 or1, joint path weight, and switching outcome.
slides.interaction: Reuses current chosen door with deterministic complete branches; no unfold or sampling requirement.

slides.title: 세 경우 중 두 경우에서 이깁니다
slides.purpose: Combine the three equiprobable prize locations.
slides.successCheck: Can count two switching wins out of three without a tie-fairness assumption.
slides.representation: Compact three-row result comparison around current choice; no full lab controls.
slides.interaction: Choice-dependent labels update; full experiment appears after sampling.

slides.title: 그런데 처음에 규칙을 말했나요?
slides.purpose: Retain the observed goat-reveal scene while distinguishing it from an unspecified host policy.
slides.successCheck: Can state that the question still concerns a goat reveal even when a different host policy is stipulated.
slides.representation: Static side-by-side guaranteed versus accidental goat procedures.
slides.interaction: Static conceptual transition; no answer gate.

slides.title: 이번 진행자는 정답을 모릅니다
slides.purpose: Specify blind uniform opening and explicitly recover the opening question: switching after a goat was revealed.
slides.successCheck: Can explain that counting only goat reveals follows from the problem condition, not a host restriction or an arbitrary discard.
slides.representation: A concise rule panel names uniform unchosen-door opening separately from the problem condition: switching after a goat reveal. No new interaction is needed; the condition precedes filtering in the connected tree.
slides.interaction: Current choice retained; hypothetical blind protocol is independent of any selected optional lab policy.

slides.title: 열 수 있는 문은 두 개씩입니다
slides.purpose: Enumerate prize location times uniformly opened door.
slides.successCheck: Can reconstruct six equally probable pairs, not six guaranteed sample outcomes.
slides.representation: A connected prize→opened-door probability tree displays all six paths with opening chance1/2 and joint path weight1/6; prize reveals are labelled but not crossed out yet.
slides.interaction: Relabel actual doors around selected choice; deterministic enumeration.

slides.title: 처음 맞혔던 경우는 모두 남습니다
slides.purpose: Restrict to the initially correct prize row.
slides.successCheck: Can explain why either unchosen opening shows a goat and both switching results lose.
slides.representation: The initially correct prize branch and its two equal opening paths remain connected; both paths show goats and switching losses.
slides.interaction: Keep selected identity; static per-row inspection.

slides.title: 처음 틀렸다면 절반만 남습니다
slides.purpose: Show why prize reveals in initially wrong games do not match the stated goat-reveal condition.
slides.successCheck: Can identify the two prize paths as possible games outside the question condition, with two goat paths inside it.
slides.representation: Two initially wrong prize branches retain their connections and four opening paths, with each prize-reveal path visibly dashed and crossed out.
slides.interaction: No hidden prior clicks; all identities and exclusion follow the named protocol.

slides.title: 남은 네 경우 중 두 경우에서 이깁니다
slides.purpose: Answer switching success among the four paths matching the observed goat reveal.
slides.successCheck: Can justify the denominator four from the problem condition before computing two wins out of four.
slides.representation: The full connected six-path tree retains two visibly excluded prize reveals alongside the four accepted paths and their switching outcomes.
slides.interaction: Current choice retained; full editable ledger is optional.

slides.title: 같은 뽑기에서 무엇이 빠질까요?
slides.purpose: Compare both host policies on paired draws while retaining only games matching the stated goat-reveal question.
slides.successCheck: Can name prize-reveal and goat-reveal counts, explain why only the latter form the denominator, and distinguish sample rates from exact values.
slides.representation: The existing compact paired simulator labels prize-reveal versus goat-reveal counts and divides switching wins by goat-reveal games. The full sample pool remains visible; exclusion is a match to the stated question, not deletion from history.
slides.interaction: Add1/100/1000 attempts, play/pause, clear attempts and select a new sample sequence. Reuse existing validated seed/count/choice, preserve state across navigation/restoration, reject invalid snapshots atomically, pause on scene/visibility change, and support independent seek/reset. No forced experiment or prediction gate.

slides.title: 같은 두 문인데, 답이 달라집니다
slides.purpose: Answer the original goat-reveal question under each explicit host policy.
slides.successCheck: Can explain that both2/3 and1/2 concern goat-reveal games and that host policy determines which possible games match that condition.
slides.representation: Compact two-policy summary; no new prerequisite or full ledger.
slides.interaction: Static synthesis after every included example and experiment.

slides.title: 2번을 우선 여는 진행자
slides.purpose: Declare a separate fixed-choice1 informed host that opens2 whenever allowed.
slides.successCheck: Can state this numbered-door scenario separately from their own chosen-door example.
slides.representation: Static diagram explicitly labelled separate fixed-choice1 example.
slides.interaction: Included static section; no reset of reader choice.

slides.title: 2번이 열린 경우만 남겨 봅시다
slides.purpose: List opened doors 2/3/2 for prize1/2/3 and retain door2 reveals.
slides.successCheck: Can identify retained prize1 and prize3 cases.
slides.representation: Static three-case opened-door table; two retained rows.
slides.interaction: Included static comparison; does not claim the free experiment supports a preferred-door policy.

slides.title: 이때는 두 경우 중 한 경우입니다
slides.purpose: Distinguish the numbered subset success1/2 from overall always-switch2/3.
slides.successCheck: Can explain why restricting to door2 changes the counted games.
slides.representation: Compact retained-case versus all-case comparison.
slides.interaction: Included numbered comparison continues to sampling; original specific URL preserved.

slides.title: 규칙을 바꾸며 더 실험해 보세요
slides.purpose: Offer the existing full deterministic host-rule ledger and optional seeded sampling.
slides.successCheck: Can compare informed4/6 and blind2/4 while distinguishing exact units from samples.
slides.representation: Existing full model-backed ledger and sampling disclosure; included after sampling before close.
slides.interaction: Retain validated LabState: changed host/choice/seed/count, invalid-input rejection, reset, restoration, navigation and independent seek. No rule/choice or sampling gate.

navigationPurpose: Every authored scene is included in Previous/Next order at its relevant context. Existing per-scene content, purpose, representation and success checks remain.
